coverLetter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Software Engineer position at HireBoost. With 7+ years of experience building scalable web applications for US and LATAM markets, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your team supporting American tech companies and startups.

Your tech stack aligns perfectly with my expertise. At Blue Creator Agency (Kimia Group), I delivered production features using Vue and Nuxt for internal CMS and consumer platforms, resolving 120+ tasks while optimizing performance metrics. At BSE America, I architected an end-to-end CRM using Laravel with RESTful API integrations, mentoring a team of 3 developers and improving code review approval rates from 40% to 85%.

What draws me to HireBoost is your commitment to collaboration, speed, and excellence. My experience at First Due—a startup founded in 2016 delivering multi-tenant SaaS to 40+ fire departments and achieving Inc 5000 recognition in 2022—has prepared me to deliver the high standards your US clients demand. I thrive in environments where I can roll up my sleeves across the full stack, from React frontends to Laravel backends to CI/CD pipelines.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to work with emerging technologies like AI, spatial computing, and blockchain. While I have hands-on experience with modern web development, I am eager to expand my skill set in these cutting-edge domains.
As a LATAM-based engineer with native Spanish and professional English proficiency, I am well-positioned to collaborate seamlessly with your US clients while working within CST timezone.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my full-stack expertise and leadership experience can contribute to HireBoost's continued growth.
